approaches_tried.approach: Investigated whether the existing monotonic-max rank clamp alone preserves status==hold across a forced live dispatch
approaches_tried.reason: It does not: hold is deliberately unranked (Phase 1), so status_vocabulary_would_regress(hold, implementing) returns false (no regression), letting the ordinary preflight write proceed and overwrite hold -> implementing. The actual hold-persistence mechanism must live in update-task-status.sh itself (Phase 3), not in the rank-based clamp -- noted for Phase 3 design.
